projects.title: Soucou 3.5
projects.description: A video game where the progression involves searching for keys in a basement, leading to a final battle that requires dodging and deflecting projectiles.
projects.description_long: Soucou 3.5 is a dungeon roaming video game where the player incarnates Cercey in the events leading from the previous Soucou game. The player is searching for various keys in the basement to keep moving between different floors and picking up power points along the way while Cercey comments on the various props and objectives in the area. The player eventually comes face to face with Lusin, the final boss of the game, prompting a bossfight. The player must dodge incoming projectiles and collect their own projectiles on the ground to throw them back at the boss.

projects.title: AdvanceTD
projects.description: A game where you have to buy towers to defend various paths against robotic enemies in an Arctic landscape.
projects.description_long: AdvanceTD is a tower defense game where the player must defend a lane from incoming enemies by placing down towers with a set budget. There are four different maps available, each with different enemies, budgets and areas to place towers in. The player can purchase and equip towers at the loadout. Towers placed in a map will begin to attack nearby enemies automatically, granting extra cash on enemy elimination.

creationProcess.p1: The game was designed by defining the necessary components, including various levels, a shop, towers, enemies, a path, and several menus. A variety of towers and enemies were designed to create a linear progression.
creationProcess.p2: Godot was chosen as the software to build the tower defense game engine. The system was designed to be configurable, making it easy to create new towers, levels, and enemies, and to assign graphical elements such as textures
creationProcess.p3: Game graphics—including textures for towers, enemies, and menus—were created using Pixelorama. The environment utilizes textures reused from a personal project of ours (a mod for the game *Mindustry*). Menu graphics were created in Figma and exported.
creationProcess.p4: The graphics and design concepts were assembled within the game engine to build the game, applying the correct textures, names, and data for towers, maps, and enemies.
creationProcess.p5: We then tested the game to ensure proper progression. Adjustments were made to variables such as player income, tower costs, and enemy health to improve the overall gameplay experience.
creationProcess.p6: Finally, the game was published on a website—in our case, hosted on GitHub Pages.

projects.title: Infiltration
projects.description: A short stop-motion film about infiltrating a border post in a supposedly authoritarian country during the Cold War.
projects.description_long: Infiltration is a short stop-motion movie set in a cold war border post. The border agent is routinely checking documents as usual for a long period of time when he notices an anomaly and is promptly shot by the intruder. Meanwhile, a separate television projects footage of rising tensions throughout the globe while the events Infiltration are occuring.

projects.title: S.0.S.
projects.description: A performance in which a walkie-talkie falls from a tower in the forest; the visual component explores the atmosphere of the forest and radio interference, while the work as a whole is a physical performance involving various controls.
projects.description_long: S.O.S. is a three-part performance between a 3D animation, interactive audio and interactive video processing. Sounds of a forest and radio interference begin to play as the projected video displays a forest and watchtower. On that watchtower is a radio, slowly malfunctioning. A walkie-talkie falls from the watchtower and we can witness the signals transmitted inside. Meanwhile, the forest continues on as normal. The audio can be interacted with and modified in real time, intensifying or lowering the different type of interferences. The video can also be deformed in real time with various glitching effects, camera tracking mimicking wind and merging together different scenes.
projects.role: Director, programmer, video editor, audio editor, 3D animator, 3D modeler
